phases.order: Retain original13 relative order. Actual pinned callback groups are synchronous and sequential: ENTER requires no active group; each group then DELEGATE_RETURN then CALLBACK_READY. Per-role entry ordinals increase; C2 may precede P2 or vice versa across recursive search selections, without an artificial flat label index. Old BEFORE_PROVIDER precedes P1_ENTER; old AFTER_PROVIDER lies after P1_DELEGATE_RETURN and before P1_CALLBACK_READY. SEARCH_RETURN may retain one unfinished group because engine catches TimeoutError (including subclasses); POSTSEARCH follows SEARCH_RETURN, then old AFTER_ENGINE/output. No missing stage is invented.
phases.positive_join: Require all outer setup/search/snapshot/output sites. Each full logged ordinal requires ENTER+DELEGATE_RETURN; each CALLBACK_READY requires its already appended observation. At most one incomplete/unlogged final callback prefix is allowed. Observation append can precede a failing READY phase.
